name: @treeseed/deployment
description: TreeSeed host bootstrap, deployment manager, edge, and Debian packaging

scripts.verify:direct: npm run check:source-shape && npm run build && npm test
scripts.artifacts:prepare: npm run artifacts:fetch && node --import tsx scripts/prepare-artifacts.ts
scripts.build:deb: npm run artifacts:prepare && npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/package-deb.ts all
scripts.verify:deb: npm run build:deb && node --import tsx scripts/verify-deb.ts
scripts.build:configured: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/configure-bootstrap.ts
scripts.build:workstation: npm run artifacts:prepare && npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/build-workstation-bootstrap.ts
